services.name: School Groups
services.desc: If you are looking for a new way to engage your students, bring your school group to the GWDC for an immersive learning experience that your students are sure to remember for a long time to come! We have the ability to host school groups both large and small from all over the region and facilitate conservation-oriented field trips. When you arrive at the GWDC you will receive an introduction and orientation from one of our Interpretive Naturalists. We are a self-guided facility with informative signage throughout the grounds, Interpretive Naturalists are available for questions and compelling educational programs are scheduled throughout the day. blurb: The BEARS: Imagination & Reality exhibit has officially been retired! The revitalized space welcomes visitors to engage with fun, interactive educational exhibits. The new displays demonstrate the integral relationships of bears and wolves within the Yellowstone ecosystem and our challenges to coexist with wildlife and wild places.
